svg.title: AlphaCode cognitive architecture: how a goal becomes a verified result
svg.desc: Animated architecture diagram. A goal enters from the left, passes through the agent loop at the center, and leaves as a verified report on the right. Around the loop are the autonomous modules (planner, project analyzer, self-review, quality gate, resource monitor), and the subsystems: system prompt, model router, tools, swarm, safety harness, sessions and memory, skills, and code search. Nine numbered steps light up in order: goal in, understand, plan, reason, safety gate, act, self-review, quality gate, report.
svg.text: Files, skills, logic and harness: how a goal becomes a verified result

g.text: numbered: workflow step, lit in order 1 to 9
